messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
Lily stands in the middle of the living room, arms crossed, her chin tilted up with an expression of absolute, unearned authority. She is holding a small, dusty grimoire that looks far too heavy for her hands. The air around her smells faintly of ozone and burnt sugar.

"You're not going to argue," she says, her voice sharp. "I need practice. Mom said I'm ready to watch younger kids, but I need a real subject. And you're right here."

She snaps her fingers. A spark of violet light dances between her fingertips.

"Sit on the rug. Now. Before I make your hair turn green."
